events.name: China Interest Rate Decision (PBoC LPR)
events.description: The PBoC's monthly Loan Prime Rate fixing, a key signal of Beijing's credit and stimulus stance for the economy.

events.name: US Chicago Fed National Activity Index
events.description: A composite of 85 US economic indicators showing whether growth is running above or below its historical trend.

events.name: Eurozone Consumer Confidence (Flash)
events.description: Preliminary gauge of eurozone household sentiment, an early signal for consumer spending and growth momentum.

events.name: US Richmond Fed Manufacturing Index
events.description: Regional factory activity survey for the Fed's Fifth District, an early read on national manufacturing trends.

events.name: US Manufacturing PMI (Flash)
events.description: Preliminary S&P Global survey of US factory activity, an early signal on output, new orders and price pressures.

events.name: UK Services PMI (Flash)
events.description: Preliminary survey of UK services-sector activity, the dominant driver of GDP and a key input to BoE policy.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Weekly count of new unemployment benefit filings, a timely, high-frequency read on US labour market health.

events.name: Germany Ifo Business Climate Index
events.description: Survey of German business sentiment on current conditions and expectations, a leading indicator for the eurozone's largest economy.

events.name: US Durable Goods Orders (M-o-M)
events.description: Measures new orders placed with manufacturers for long-lasting goods, a gauge of business investment and factory demand.

events.name: UK GfK Consumer Confidence
events.description: Survey of UK household sentiment on personal finances and the wider economy, a guide to consumer spending trends.
